name: Codespell with annotations
description: Codespell with annotations for Pull Request

builtin.description: Comma-separated list of builtin dictionaries to include

check_filenames.description: If set, check file names as well

check_hidden.description: If set, check hidden files (those starting with ".") as well

config.description: Path to a codespell config file

exclude_file.description: File with lines that should not be checked for spelling mistakes

ignore_words_file.description: File with a list of words to be ignored. Words are case sensitive based on how they are written in the dictionary file

ignore_words_list.description: Comma-separated list of words to be ignored. Words are case sensitive based on how they are written in the dictionary file

uri_ignore_words_list.description: comma separated list of words to be ignored in URIs and emails only

skip.description: Comma-separated list of files to skip (it accepts globs as well)

only_warn.description: If set, only warn, never error
